samples.text: Part 3. You will hear two students called Hugo and Chantal discussing a talk they have just attended at the start of their course in fashion design. But then this guy sat right in front of me and he was so tall. It's hard to see through people's heads, isn't it? Impossible! Anyway, to answer your question, I thought it was really interesting.
